label: HA Stock App Notifications
info:
Listens once for ha_stock_app_* events and sends formatted notifications
to notify.mobile_app_owner.

One subscription, one router, one formatter per event. Set the action on
the Mobile Notify node to your own device.

Test with the integration's Send Test Notification button.
